(sec-module-symbolics.useritems)=
# Module: symbolics.userItems

User items with the interfaces of the built-in items (#3111, #3125, design:
docs/dev/design/symbolicUserItems.md): UserItemCreator(mbs) has the Create functions of mbs with the same
arguments, and creates ObjectUserBody and ObjectConnectorUser instead of the built-in objects, with the same
nodes, markers and loads. The user functions are Python functions, so that the system runs in Exudyn as
built; Record() replaces them by one symbolic recording per kind of item, which SymbolicSystem and the
export take. A script that builds a system with creator = mbs builds the same system of user items with
creator = UserItemCreator(mbs).
The items: CreateGround, CreateMassPoint, CreateRigidBody (on NodeRigidBodyRxyz), CreateSpringDamper,
CreateTorsionalSpringDamper, CreateRevoluteJoint, CreatePrismaticJoint, CreateSphericalJoint,
CreateDistanceConstraint (ObjectJointUser, #3140), CreateForce. An argument a user item does not support
raises, naming it. A parameter of a mass point or a spring-damper may be a named exudyn.symbolic.Real
(mass=m1): the item gets its value, the creator keeps the variable in parameterVariables, for
SymbolicSystem(mbs, parameters=creator.parameterVariables) (#3152).

- **Author**: Johannes Gerstmayr
- **Date**: 2026-10-27 (created)

## Function: _JointGraphics

[`_JointGraphics(markers, shape, size, length, color)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/userItems.py#L276)

- **function description**: the graphicsDataUserFunction of a joint of UserItemCreator (#3147), a simplified drawing at its markers in the visualization configuration: 'revolute' a cylinder along the z-axis of marker 0, 'prismatic' along its x-axis, 'spherical' a sphere at marker 0, 'distance' a line - or a cylinder of diameter size > 0 - between the markers


(sec-module-symbolics.useritems-class-useritemcreator)=
## CLASS UserItemCreator (in module symbolics.userItems)

**class description**: creates user items with the Create functions of mbs and their arguments (#3125): ObjectUserBody and ObjectConnectorUser with Python user functions instead of the built-in objects, recorded as symbolic user functions by Record, one recording per kind of item; see the Details of this module

- **input**:
  - `mbs`: the MainSystem where the items are created
- **notes**: Its members: mbs; items, the dict of the item numbers of each kind ('massPoint', 'rigidBody', 'springDamper', 'torsionalSpringDamper', 'revoluteJoint', 'prismaticJoint', 'sphericalJoint', 'distanceConstraint'); loads, the list of the loads with a user function created by CreateForce; recordings, the symbolic user functions of Record, which must live as long as the system; parameterVariables, the dict of the parameters of the items with a named exudyn.symbolic.Real among them - CreateMassPoint(mass=m1) -, by the int of the item number, as SymbolicSystem(mbs, parameters=...) takes it (#3152). Example: creator = UserItemCreator(mbs) #or creator = mbs: the same script with the built-in items b0 = creator.CreateMassPoint(referencePosition=[1,0,0], mass=2, gravity=[0,-9.81,0]) creator.CreateSpringDamper(itemNumbers=[creator.CreateGround(), b0], stiffness=100, damping=1) creator.Record() mbs.Assemble()

(sec-useritems-useritemcreator-createrigidbody)=
### Class function: CreateRigidBody

[`CreateRigidBody(self, name = '', referencePosition = None, referenceRotationMatrix = None, initialVelocity = [0., 0., 0.], initialAngularVelocity = [0., 0., 0.], initialDisplacement = None, initialRotationMatrix = None, inertia = None, gravity = [0., 0., 0.], nodeType = exudyn.NodeType.RotationEulerParameters, graphicsDataList = [], graphicsDataUserFunction = 0, drawSize = -1, color = [-1., -1., -1., -1.], show = True, create2D = False, returnDict = False, referenceHT = None, initialHT = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/userItems.py#L403)

- **class function description**: a rigid body as ObjectUserBody on a NodeRigidBodyRxyz, with the node, markers and loads of mbs.CreateRigidBody and its arguments; nodeType must be exu.NodeType.RotationRxyz
- **input**:
  - `name`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
  - `referencePosition`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
  - `referenceRotationMatrix`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
  - `initialVelocity`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
  - `initialAngularVelocity`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
  - `initialDisplacement`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
  - `initialRotationMatrix`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
  - `inertia`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody; its mass, inertia about the node and center of mass are the parameters of the user body
  - `gravity`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody

  - `graphicsDataUserFunction`: refused if given: the one of ObjectUserBody has other arguments
  - `drawSize`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
  - `color`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
  - `show`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
  - `create2D`: refused if True: a planar user rigid body does not exist yet
  - `returnDict`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
  - `referenceHT`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
  - `initialHT`: as in mbs.CreateRigidBody
- **output**: the ObjectIndex of the body, or with returnDict the dict of mbs.CreateRigidBody

### Class function: CreateTorsionalSpringDamper

[`CreateTorsionalSpringDamper(self, name = '', itemNumbers = [None, None], position = [0., 0., 0.], axis = [0., 0., 0.], stiffness = 0., damping = 0., offset = 0., velocityOffset = 0., torque = 0., useGlobalFrame = True, springTorqueUserFunction = 0, unlimitedRotations = True, show = True, drawSize = -1, color = exudyn.graphics.color.default, bodyNumbers = None, bodyOrNodeList = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/userItems.py#L547)

- **input**:
  - `name`: as in mbs.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper
  - `itemNumbers`: as in mbs.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper, two bodies or the ground
  - `position`: as in mbs.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper
  - `axis`: as in mbs.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper
  - `stiffness`: as in mbs.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper; a number or a named exudyn.symbolic.Real
  - `damping`: as in mbs.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper; a number or a named exudyn.symbolic.Real
  - `offset`: as in mbs.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper; a number or a named exudyn.symbolic.Real
  - `velocityOffset`: as in mbs.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper; a number or a named exudyn.symbolic.Real
  - `torque`: as in mbs.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper; a number or a named exudyn.symbolic.Real
  - `useGlobalFrame`: as in mbs.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper
  - `springTorqueUserFunction`: refused if given: the torque is the forceUserFunction of the connector
  - `unlimitedRotations`: must be False: the turns need a data coordinate, which the symbolic system does not take
  - `show`: as in mbs.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper

(sec-useritems-useritemcreator-record)=
### Class function: Record

[`Record(self)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/userItems.py#L793)

- **class function description**: replace the Python user functions of the items by symbolic ones: each user function of a kind recorded once, with the first item of the kind, and set in every item of the kind - one recording per kind, as SymbolicSystem groups them -; the loadVectorUserFunction of each force of CreateForce recorded on its own. The recordings are kept in recordings, as long as this object lives
